title: Band Of Gypsys
notes:
Cat# "STAO-472" on front cover, inside gatefold, spine and labels.

Tracks B1, B4 Published by Miles Ahead Music Inc., all others Bella Godiva Music Inc.
Recorded live — New Year's Eve 69-70 at Fillmore East in New York
Produced by Heaven Research
Background by Joshua Light Show
Printed in U.S.A.

Lacquer cut at [url=https://www.discogs.com/label/264060-Sterling-Sound]Sterling Sound[/url] from 'STERLING' in runout.
Pressed by [url=https://www.discogs.com/label/314605-Capitol-Records-Pressing-Plant-Jacksonville]Capitol Records Pressing Plant, Jacksonville[/url] from "0" stamped in runout.
Runout details: everything is hand etched, except Sterling logo and pressing plant ID "0" which are stamped on each side.

This release has:
1) Capitol logo with ® (not ™) on labels,
2) Track titles "Power To Love" and "Message Of Love" on back cover and label side B,
3) Heaven Research credit located separately from the other credits on back cover, 
4) Capitol credits along the bottom edge of the back cover.

For similar Jacksonville releases, see:
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/20059057-Hendrix-Band-Of-Gypsys]Band Of Gypsys[/url], strictly similar but with Capitol logo ™ on labels (not ®),
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/8460527-Hendrix-Band-Of-Gypsys]Band Of Gypsys[/url] with a Gold Record sticker on front cover, with Capitol logo ™ on labels (not ®), and without Capitol credits along the bottom edge of the back cover,
- [url=https://www.discogs.com/release/16801371-Hendrix-Band-Of-Gypsys]Band Of Gypsys[/url] with titles "Power Of Soul" and "Message To Love" on back cover and label side B, and without Capitol credits along the bottom edge of the back cover.
